gate.inputs_description: V11 normalized state18, frozen V10 velocity3 and frozen V11 velocity3; candidate velocities clipped to +/-2 m/s
gate.output: scalar sigmoid; translation = V10 + g * (V11 - V10); raw training rotation residual stays V10; native calibrated gyro unchanged
gate.memory: previous blended pre-visual displacement/dt, transported into endpoint-camera axes; same V11 valid/gap/clip contract

selection: Minimum complete original-validation pose loss over updated epochs 1..40 for each experimental candidate; record initial, hard-zero and hard-one references. No default promotion. Freeze selected candidate before all long evaluation.
training_contract: Only gate weights change. Same original data, normalization, target-frame sampling plan, 20-frame contexts, self-predicted history, pose plus 2x warping loss, 40 epochs and 1520 optimizer steps. Constant control trains one sigmoid bias; adaptive gate trains 209 parameters. No new supervision, history augmentation, visual inputs or stationary detector.

evaluation.timing: all 24 execution orders per 24-frame block; repeat and endpoint checks outside timing; fresh timing after generation/training/build finish

scope: Gate only. Freeze V10/V11 predictor weights and native vision/rotation algorithms. Preserve all older branches/artifacts. No ZUPT, visual cadence change, training-data change, main merge, or server upload. Missing motion coverage stays inconclusive; do not select flights by estimator scores.
